contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 so (6,6) lies outside published CKgP range) and with packet nodes C66-GEO-COMP / C66-TATE-SUPPORT. Independent primary checks. (1) Branch arithmetic: Riemann–Hurwitz for smooth degree-4 covers of P^1 of genus 6 gives 2g-2=4(-2)+R so R=18; the classical finite branch morphism from the (simple/ordered) tetragonal Hurwitz stack lands in an open of M_0,18 (or an S_18-cover thereof). (2) Genus-zero base: SRC-0004 / Canning–Larson record Keel’s theorem that Chow and cohomology of Mbar_0,n are tautological for all n, hence pure Tate after rational coefficients; the open M_0,n likewise has mixed-Tate / polynomial-count cohomology with constant coefficients. (3) Finite pushforward: for a finite (étale) morphism f:X→Y one has H^*(X;Q)≅H^*(Y;f_*Q), and f_* of a locally constant sheaf remains locally constant (Stacks Project tag 095B); for the Hurwitz branch map, f_*Q is a local system of rank equal to the cover degree whose monodromy is the Hurwitz braid / mapping-class action on covers, not a priori a sum of Tate systems. (4) Non-implication: mixed-Tate cohomology of Y with constant coefficients does not imply mixed-Tate cohomology of Y with coefficients in a non-constant local system L=f_*Q, nor of the total space X. (5) Averaging direction: for a finite Galois cover, H^*(Y;Q)≅H^*(X;Q)^G, so Q-linear averaging/transfer only descends an already established Tate structure from cover to base; it cannot ascend Tate from M_0,18 to the Hurwitz stack. Relative projective-bundle / linear-system opens over the Hurwitz stack inherit the same obstruction: the projective-bundle theorem preserves Tate only after the base is already Tate. (6) CKgP contrast (do not conflate): SRC-0004 Lemma 3.10 shows CKgP does descend along proper surjections, so permanence of CKgP along Hurwitz→gonality-stratum is valid in Chow; the finding correctly blocks the parallel claim for mixed-Tate / pure-weight cohomology. Distinct from corroborated FND-0053 (S_6-ordering covers of configuration/linear-system spaces—different cover), FND-0054 (declaring the Hurwitz space rational/Tate upgrades a prediction without C66-TATE-SUPPORT—meta, not the branch-map local-system calculus), and FND-0002 (CKgP non-ascent along finite étale ordering). Merge target: none. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent primary-source verification of RH branch count, genus-zero Tate base, finite-pushforward local systems, and the one-way character of rational averaging.
